description: This file defines multiple Marshmallow schemas related to SQL Lab functionalities in Apache Superset, including schemas for query execution, results, tables, and UI state management.

classes.name: EstimateQueryCostSchema
classes.description: Schema for estimating query cost, including database ID, SQL, and optional catalog/schema.

classes.name: FormatQueryPayloadSchema
classes.description: Schema for formatting SQL query payload, including SQL, engine, database ID, and template parameters.

classes.name: ExecutePayloadSchema
classes.description: Schema for executing SQL queries, including various parameters like database ID, SQL, client ID, and execution options.

classes.name: QueryResultSchema
classes.description: Schema representing the structure of query result data, including metadata like execution time, SQL, user, and result metrics.

classes.name: QueryExecutionResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for the response of a query execution, including status, data, columns, and nested query info.

classes.name: TableSchema
classes.description: Schema for database table metadata, including ID, description, schema, and table name.

classes.name: TabStateSchema
classes.description: Schema for the state of a SQL editor tab, including active status, SQL content, associated query, and related table schemas.

classes.name: SQLLabBootstrapSchema
classes.description: Schema for the initial state of SQL Lab, including active tab, databases, queries, and tab state IDs.

methods.name: fields.Integer
methods.description: Defines an integer field in a schema.

methods.name: fields.String
methods.description: Defines a string field in a schema.

methods.name: fields.Dict
methods.description: Defines a dictionary field in a schema.

methods.name: fields.DateTime
methods.description: Defines a datetime field in a schema.

methods.name: fields.List
methods.description: Defines a list of items in a schema.

methods.name: fields.Boolean
methods.description: Defines a boolean field in a schema.

methods.name: fields.Nested
methods.description: Defines a nested schema within another schema.
